snippets.snippet_text: "Currency Conversion Fees: If you're selling to customers in different countries, Gumroad charges a currency conversion fee. All transactions are processed in US dollars, so if you sell in another currency, Gumroad will convert it to USD at the time of the transaction. The exact fee for this conversion depends on the rates set by Gumroad's payment processors."

possible_subjects: Wise blog (published September 11, 2024) on Gumroad fees: all Gumroad transactions processed in USD; currency conversion fee applies for non-USD transactions at time of sale; exact conversion fee amount depends on Gumroad's payment processor rates (unspecified)
